mapper.select: SELECT name, content, COALESCE(status, 'LISTED') AS status FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT o.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), s.publication_price) - s.prev_price FROM stocks s WHERE s.stock_id = #{stockId}

SELECT COALESCE( ROUND( (COALESCE( (SELECT o.price FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY t.created_date DESC LIMIT 1), s.publication_price) - s.prev_price) / NULLIF(s.prev_price, 0) * 100), 0) as ChangeRate FROM stocks s WHERE s.stock_id = #{stockId}
SELECT prev_price FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o ON t.buy_order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.stock_id = #{stockId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN content IN ('매수', 'BUY') THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('체결', 'MATCHED') FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(total_point, 0) FROM students WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (content, price, amount, state, created_date, student_id, stock_id) VALUES (#{content}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{state}, NOW(), COALESCE((SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1), #{studentId}), #{stockId})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, student_id, stock_id, price, amount, content, state, created_date FROM orders WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING') ORDER BY created_date ASC

SELECT order_id, student_id, stock_id, price, amount, content, state, created_date FROM orders WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING') AND content IN ('매도', 'SELL') ORDER BY created_date ASC

SELECT order_id, student_id, stock_id, price, amount, content, state, created_date FROM orders WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING') AND content IN ('매수', 'BUY') ORDER BY created_date ASC

SELECT order_id, content, price, amount, created_date, state FROM orders WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR student_id = (SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1)) AND stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING') ORDER BY created_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET total_point = total_point + #{totalPrice} WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1))
UPDATE students SET total_point = total_point - #{totalPrice} WHERE (student_id = #{studentId} OR id = (SELECT id FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_transactions (created_date, buy_order_id, sell_order_id, amount, price) VALUES (NOW(), #{buyOrderId}, #{sellOrderId}, #{amount}, #{price})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET state = '대기' WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE orders SET state = 'MATCHED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE orders SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT publication_balance, publication_price FROM stocks WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE stocks SET publication_balance = publication_balance - #{buyAmount} WHERE stock_id = #{stockId}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, content, price, amount, state, created_date, student_id, stock_id FROM orders WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING') AND content = #{content} AND price = #{orderPrice} AND amount = #{orderAmount} AND student_id != COALESCE((SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1), #{studentId}) ORDER BY created_date ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (content, price, amount, state, created_date, student_id, stock_id) VALUES (#{content}, #{price}, #{amount}, #{state}, NOW(), COALESCE((SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) FROM students WHERE student_id = #{studentId} LIMIT 1), #{studentId}), #{stockId})
mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.content, o.price, o.amount, o.state, COALESCE(s.student_id, o.student_id) AS student_id, o.stock_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN students s ON (o.student_id = CAST(s.id AS CHAR) OR o.student_id = s.student_id) WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET state = 'CANCELLED' WHERE stock_id = #{stockId} AND state IN ('대기', 'WAITING')
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.created_date AS created_date, t.amount AS amount, t.price AS price, (t.amount * t.price) AS total_price, COALESCE(s_buy.student_id, o_buy.student_id) AS buyer_student_id, COALESCE(s_buy.name, '시스템(매수)') AS buyer_name, COALESCE(s_sell.student_id, o_sell.student_id) AS seller_student_id, COALESCE(s_sell.name, CASE WHEN o_sell.student_id = 'SYSTEM_LP' THEN '초기발행(LP)' ELSE '시스템(매도)' END) AS seller_name FROM stock_transactions t JOIN orders o_buy ON t.buy_order_id = o_buy.order_id LEFT JOIN students s_buy ON (o_buy.student_id = CAST(s_buy.id AS CHAR) OR o_buy.student_id = s_buy.student_id) LEFT JOIN orders o_sell ON t.sell_order_id = o_sell.order_id LEFT JOIN students s_sell ON (o_sell.student_id = CAST(s_sell.id AS CHAR) OR o_sell.student_id = s_sell.student_id) WHERE o_buy.stock_id = #{stockId} ORDER BY t.created_date DESC, t.transaction_id DESC
